name: bug_academybugs_twitter_share_nxdomain_01
description: Clicking the X/Twitter social share button on a product page on AcademyBugs.com results in a DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN error.

nodes.content: Launch a new instance of the Firefox browser.

metadata.expected_result: A new Firefox browser window is open and active.

nodes.content: In the Firefox address bar, type 'https://academybugs.com/find-bugs/' and press Enter to navigate to the page.

metadata.expected_result: The 'Find Bugs' page on AcademyBugs.com is loaded and displayed in the browser.

nodes.content: On the 'Find Bugs' page (https://academybugs.com/find-bugs/), locate the list of products. Click on the name or link of the first product available in the list (e.g., 'DNK Yellow Shoes').

metadata.expected_result: The product detail page for the selected product is loaded and displayed.

nodes.content: On the loaded product detail page, find the section for social media sharing. Identify the icon representing 'X' (formerly Twitter).

metadata.expected_result: The 'X' (Twitter) social share icon is located on the page.
The browser attempts to open a new tab or navigate the current tab to a Twitter sharing URL.

nodes.content: Observe the browser's current tab or any newly opened tab for an error page.

metadata.expected_result: The browser displays an error page stating 'This site can't be reached' with a 'DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN' error code.

nodes.content: (Optional) Open the browser's developer tools (typically by pressing F12). Navigate to the 'Console' and 'Network' tabs to look for specific DNS-related errors (e.g., NXDOMAIN).

metadata.expected_result: Developer tools console or network tab shows errors related to DNS resolution for the Twitter share link domain.

verification_steps: Confirm that after clicking the X/Twitter share icon on a product page, the browser displays an error page with the message 'This site can't be reached' and the error code 'DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN'.
